historical_scope: Original project trials retained; subsequent code/source changes and fixed-reference benchmark are qualified separately, not retroactively applied to these terminal results.
historical_baseline: gateway-building.json (333 Python tests, 233 mutations, Gradle and 10 TLS checks; original artifacts retained)
architecture: External tool-free model authors typed persistent project and BCL. Existing compiler/IR/BCLJobs/AgentRuntime/native motors execute. No house action template, hardcoded Survival progression, custom physics or transport rewrite.

assessment.stage_A: GO: one independently accepted uninterrupted fresh controlled supplied-material trial
assessment.recovery: CONDITIONAL: real lost acknowledgement, durable intent, fresh actor binding and 56 unique placements proven; complete accessible goal after recovery NOT verified
assessment.stage_B: CONDITIONAL GO: empty-inventory LLM material/build objective independently proven in controlled Peaceful Survival; original autonomous terminal/verification reliability still failed

implemented: Strict generic project plans/sections/materials/revisions on existing private POSIX SQLite SessionStore
Explicit binding and conservative fresh activation revalidation; durable intent, high-water dedup and no uncertain replay
Separate planned state/actions/observations/current progress/final objective; observed missing/wrong/unknown distinctions
Full-cube absence only from bounded native body clearance; native reachable interior/floor/headroom/doorway proof
Independent enclosure policy fixed before trials, no model finish/command receipt goal laundering
State-based baseline-unmet to current-correct construction witness, no receipt prerequisite after lost ACK
Per-material inventory/shortfall and independent native recipe output arithmetic, no resource policy
Bounded external-model SDK host; summaries, budgets, separate last action vs follow-up observation, relevant-progress stop
Idempotent fresh desired placement without use/consumption; full-cube plank placement/support
Bounded native candidate-pose diagnostics, optional one-attack ordinary flower clearance with fresh support reacquisition
I4 single model-selected voxel support/face adapter over existing I3, never retrying uncertain use
Generic independent bounded face-centre inspection with per-target native pose revisits, through existing BCL only

model.decisions: Real audited requests/replies, not manual replies or replayed construction strategy.

A.world: Restored CLOSED unbuilt Blockwire BCL Building A01 baseline
A.provided: 64 cobblestone; ONLY supplied-material mechanics, no Survival resource claim

B.scope: Controlled peaceful Survival, not Normal/hostile/food/24x7 qualification. Creation UI and empty inventory recorded. B01 preflight world was closed before model work; B02 verifies bonus OFF explicitly.

independent_verification.source: Only real native V0 block surfaces/native geometry after final potential world mutation; conservative sample lower bounds for legacy timestamp-less frames. No saved block/NBT query or action-plan inference.
